name: b21-not-eq
selftest_fail_arms: (i) an 8-hex prefix of a 40-hex URL segment on a mined registry row → declared, no finding
(ii) a cited full 40-hex pin that is a complete URL segment → declared, no finding
(iii) pin followed by `#fragment` (`/commit/<pin>#diff`) → declared, no finding
text mode: COMMIT_CITED_UNRESOLVED detail carries `declared=<n>` beside the unresolved list
text mode: a green round with a declared pin prints one `info COMMIT_CITED_DECLARED` line, no finding
(xv) unescaped `|` shifting a truly `rejected` status → unresolved, id in malformedRows
(xvi) escaped `\|` row (naive split yields 14 fields) → unresolved, id in malformedRows
(xvii) 12-field short row → unresolved, id in malformedRows (kills lenient12/gt13-only)
(xviii) 14-field long row → unresolved, id in malformedRows
(xix) a well-formed row next to a malformed one still declares, only the malformed token is unresolved (kills dropall)
(xx) malformedRows exact order/content in file order (kills nodisclose)
(xxi) URL-less, 3-space-indented, repeated and low-sorting malformed rows are each listed in file order; a CRLF 13-field row and an off-enum status still declare
(xxii) a 12-field row whose index-8 cell reads `rejected` is still listed in malformedRows (shape before status)
text mode: malformed rows get one `info SOURCES_ROWS_MALFORMED` line; the r94 declared line keeps its format
(xxiii) R96 battery: only inside 13-field non-rejected rows declare; outside rows listed in file order with repeats; inside short row is malformed
(xxv) text mode: outside rows get one `info SOURCES_ROWS_OUTSIDE` line right after the malformed line (kills notext)
hermeticity: --selftest passes under a polluted env and bogus dir flags
